audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicts its own prose. It gives Ryze Level 1 while content early and whys[0] both say 'Ryze is weakest at level 1 — run through him early'. It gives Singed Levels 4-5 while whys[3] says 'Neither of you has a dominant window here'. It gives Singed First item while whys[5] says his Seraph's spike 'can burst through Insanity Potion's regen'.
audit.why: Emerald+ 54.30% over 895 games — Singed is ahead overall, but the shape is front-loaded, not back-loaded: Ryze at level 1 has one 1000-range poke and no lockdown, and he scales into a raid boss. The packet chart agrees on levels 1-2 going to Singed and on the mid-lane being even. Ryze's own text is the tiebreaker for the later stages.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one group to Singed, Singed, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Ryze, Skill, with each phases[N].why rewritten to match its new side. Both layers moved together.

audit.why: Levels 1-2, level 6 Realm Warp, Rylai's, and full-build Ryze — the four spikes are the right ones. Realm Warp is 180/160/140s so at rank 1 it is a once-every-three-minutes macro threat, which supports treating level 6 as a reason to ward rather than a reason to duel. Insanity Potion is a flat 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Prison is called a root everywhere — 'His point-blank root', 'Land Rune Prison (W) to root you in place', 'a Rune Prison into full chain'. It is not a root by itself. It is also not point-blank. And the content late paragraph calls Spell Flux a shield: 'even through his shield (Spell Flux E)'.
audit.why: Riot's Rune Prison text: 'Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' So the root only exists as a two-piece: Spell Flux (E, 3.5s at rank 1, 615 range) must land first. Dodge the orb and the cage is merely a slow you can keep running through — which is the entire matchup for a champion whose win condition is running. Rune Prison is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s at 615 range, not point-blank. Spell Flux is a damage-and-debuff orb, not a shield; nothing in Ryze's kit shields.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns, focus.text, phases[1].why, phases[2].why, content wants.foe[0] and content late all now state the Flux-first requirement, and the fabricated shield is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Rune Prison as the thing to track with no numbers, and never mentions Spell Flux at all.
audit.why: Spell Flux is 3.5/3.25/3/2.75/2.5s — effectively always available, so you cannot wait it out; you dodge it. Rune Prison at 11s rank 1 is the cooldown that actually opens a window, and Realm Warp is 180s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with all four numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page twice calls Ryze short-ranged ('Ryze's short-range zone', 'Ryze's short range forces him into it').
audit.why: Overload is 1000 range — longer than anything Singed has except the 1000-range Mega Adhesive throw. Only Rune Prison and Spell Flux are 615. Telling a Singed player Ryze is short-ranged invites him to walk into free Overload poke.
audit.corrected: Left the two spikes[2] and wants.you[0] strings alone rather than force them out of the length band; recorded here and in notes.

edits.before: You lose most level-1 duels — set up the proxy game instead. Identify how Ryze contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Ryze is at his weakest here — Overload alone is modest and Rune Prison is not up yet. Run Poison Trail through him and own the first wave.

edits.before: Fling + glue starts punishing anyone who chases. Only take the trade when Ryze's Rune Prison is down.
edits.after: Fling plus goo punishes any chase, and Rune Prison alone only slows — it roots you only through Spell Flux.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ryze must walk into your range.
edits.after: His full kit lands too: Spell Flux into Rune Prison is a real root and a Q-reset chain. Contest, but never duel into it.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Rune Prison's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Neither side owns this window. Proxy behind his wave and bank gold — denying Ryze his item tempo beats any duel you could win here.

edits.before: Rylai's Crystal Scepter is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Rune Prison's cooldown.
edits.after: Rylai's lands, but Seraph's plus a Flux-into-Rune Prison chain out-bursts your regen — take the side lane.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Ryze carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Your cloud is inescapable now, but a Ryze who lands the root still kills you. Carry threat 8.5/10 — side-lane, never 1v1.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rune Prison is 615 range and only a slow — it roots you only if Spell Flux landed first.

edits.before: Track Ryze's Rune Prison: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. When it is down — Fling into goo, poison out.
edits.after: Rune Prison only roots through Spell Flux — dodge the orb and the cage is a slow. Then Fling him into your goo.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Spell Flux: 3.5s at rank 1 — always up, so dodge it rather than wait it out. It is what turns the cage into a root. - Rune Prison: 11s, 615 range. - Realm Warp: 180s. - Insanity Potion: flat 100s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Land Rune Prison (W) to root you in place and chain Q resets into a full burst rotation
edits.after: Land Spell Flux first so Rune Prison roots instead of slows, then chain Overload resets

edits.before: Post-Rylai's you are a side-lane monster — the permaslow on Poison Trail means Ryze can never simply walk out of your cloud, and Fling into the sticky goo roots him long enough for the cloud to stack meaningful damage even through his shield (Spell Flux E). The real threat is Ryze's raid-boss scaling: at two items his Q damage becomes enormous and one root-chain can delete you before Insanity Potion's regeneration saves you. Keep the side lane rather than joining teamfights he can warp into, and never fight him in an open brush where he can Rune Prison you at his leisure — always run past him so his root has to land on a moving target in a narrow window.
edits.after: Post-Rylai's you are a side-lane monster — the permaslow means Ryze can never simply walk out of your cloud, and Fling into the goo roots him long enough for the poison to stack real damage. The threat is his scaling: at two items Overload is enormous, and Spell Flux into Rune Prison is a genuine root chain that deletes you before Insanity Potion's regen matters. Keep the side lane rather than joining teamfights he can Realm Warp into, and never stand still in an open brush. Spell Flux is the orb that upgrades his cage from a slow to a root, so dodge that first and make him land it on a moving target.

notes: Two 'Ryze is short-ranged' claims survive: spikes[2] ('Ryze's short range forces him into it every time he wants to Q you') and wants.you[0] ('Run Poison Trail through Ryze's short-range zone'). Overload is 1000 range, so both are wrong, but neither rewrites inside the length band without losing the point they exist to make — flagged here for a later pass. Also unverified and therefore left out of the copy: the content mid paragraph asserts Realm Warp has a 'five-second channel'. Riot's text says only 'After a few seconds', and I could not confirm the exact number from the kit data, so I did not repeat or correct the figure.
